content_en:
Before entering a new market, a marketing team needs to understand local customers, competitors, and business conditions. Our company planned to introduce a smart home product in Germany, so I was responsible for preparing an initial market research report.

I started by identifying our target audience. We focused on young professionals and families who were interested in energy saving and home automation. Then I reviewed industry reports, competitor websites, customer reviews, and online discussions. These sources helped me understand what customers valued and what problems they often experienced.

I also compared the prices and features of similar products. Some competitors offered lower prices, while others focused on product quality and customer service. I noticed that German customers paid close attention to product safety, energy efficiency, and clear technical information.

To understand the market more directly, I interviewed several potential customers and asked about their buying habits. Their feedback showed that trust and after-sales support were important factors in purchasing decisions.

Finally, I summarized the findings and presented the main opportunities and risks to the management team. The research helped us adjust our positioning before investing in advertising. Good market research reduces uncertainty and helps a company make better decisions.
content_cn:
进入一个新市场之前，营销团队需要了解当地客户、竞争对手和商业环境。我们公司计划在德国推出一款智能家居产品，因此我负责准备一份初步市场调研报告。

我首先确定了目标受众。我们重点关注对节能和家庭自动化感兴趣的年轻职场人士和家庭。随后，我查阅了行业报告、竞争对手网站、客户评价和网络讨论。这些资料帮助我了解客户看重什么，以及他们经常遇到哪些问题。

我还比较了同类产品的价格和功能。一些竞争对手提供更低的价格，另一些则强调产品质量和客户服务。我注意到，德国客户非常关注产品安全、能源效率和清晰的技术信息。

为了更直接地了解市场，我采访了几位潜在客户，并询问他们的购买习惯。他们的反馈表明，信任感和售后支持是影响购买决策的重要因素。

最后，我总结了调研结果，并向管理团队介绍了主要机会和风险。这项研究帮助我们在投入广告预算之前调整产品定位。良好的市场调研能够减少不确定性，帮助企业做出更好的决策。

profession_name: International Marketing / 海外市场营销

content_en:
When a company enters a foreign market, translating its website is not enough. Marketing content should also match local language habits, culture, and customer expectations. Last month, our team prepared a campaign for customers in Japan.

The original campaign was written in English. It used direct language and several jokes that worked well in the United States. However, a simple translation sounded unnatural in Japanese. Some expressions also carried meanings that were not suitable for the local audience.

I worked with a local translator and a marketing specialist to review the content. We changed the headlines, adjusted the tone, and replaced some examples with situations that Japanese customers could easily understand. We also checked product descriptions, payment information, and customer service messages.

Visual content needed attention too. We reviewed the images, colors, and layout to make sure they were appropriate for the local market. The goal was not to change our brand identity, but to communicate it in a more familiar way.

Before publishing the campaign, we asked a small group of local users to review the new version. Their comments helped us improve several details. Effective localization goes beyond translation. It makes a brand feel relevant and trustworthy to people in different markets.
content_cn:
企业进入海外市场时，仅仅翻译网站内容是不够的。营销内容还应该符合当地的语言习惯、文化和客户期望。上个月，我们团队为日本客户准备了一场营销活动。

最初的活动文案是用英语写的。它使用了直接的表达方式，还包含几个在美国市场效果不错的笑话。然而，简单翻译成日语后，读起来并不自然。一些表达在当地文化中也带有不适合目标受众的含义。

我与一位本地译者和一位营销专家合作审查内容。我们修改了标题，调整了语气，并用日本客户容易理解的场景替换了部分例子。我们还检查了产品描述、支付信息和客户服务消息。

视觉内容同样需要关注。我们检查了图片、颜色和版式，确保它们适合当地市场。我们的目标不是改变品牌形象，而是用一种更容易被当地消费者接受的方式传达品牌价值。

在正式发布活动之前，我们邀请了一小群当地用户审阅新版本。他们的意见帮助我们改进了几个细节。有效的本地化不只是翻译，它能让不同市场的消费者感受到品牌的相关性和可信度。

profession_name: International Marketing / 海外市场营销

content_en:
An international marketing campaign needs a clear goal, a suitable audience, and a realistic budget. Our company planned to promote a new fitness product in three markets: the United Kingdom, Australia, and Singapore. I was responsible for coordinating the campaign plan.

First, we agreed on the main objective. We wanted to increase brand awareness and generate qualified leads. Then I worked with the local teams to define the target audience in each market. Although the product was the same, customer interests and media habits were different.

We selected several channels, including search advertising, social media, email marketing, and influencer partnerships. Each channel had a specific role. Search ads could reach people who were already looking for similar products, while social media could introduce the brand to new audiences.

I prepared a campaign calendar with key dates, content deadlines, and budget estimates. We also agreed on performance indicators, such as website visits, lead conversion rate, and cost per lead. This gave the team a shared way to measure progress.

Before launch, I checked that all teams understood their responsibilities. We also prepared alternative content in case an advertisement performed poorly. A well-planned campaign gives the team direction while leaving enough room to respond to market changes.
content_cn:
一场国际营销活动需要明确的目标、合适的受众和现实可行的预算。我们公司计划在英国、澳大利亚和新加坡三个市场推广一款新的健身产品。我负责协调整体活动方案。

首先，我们确定了主要目标：提高品牌知名度，并获取高质量的潜在客户。随后，我与当地团队合作，明确每个市场的目标受众。虽然产品相同，但不同市场的客户兴趣和媒体使用习惯有所不同。

我们选择了多个营销渠道，包括搜索广告、社交媒体、电子邮件营销和网红合作。每个渠道都有明确的作用。搜索广告可以触达已经在寻找类似产品的人，而社交媒体则可以向新的受众介绍品牌。

我制定了一份营销活动日历，其中包含重要日期、内容交付时间和预算估算。我们还确定了绩效指标，例如网站访问量、潜在客户转化率和每条潜在客户线索的成本。这让团队能够使用统一的方式衡量进展。

上线之前，我检查了所有团队是否清楚各自的职责。我们还准备了备用内容，以防某个广告效果不佳。周密的活动策划能为团队提供方向，同时保留足够的空间应对市场变化。

profession_name: International Marketing / 海外市场营销

content_en:
Digital advertising allows companies to reach specific audiences, but campaigns need regular monitoring. I manage online advertising for our company's new software product. Our main channels are Google Ads and LinkedIn.

At the beginning of each campaign, I define the audience, daily budget, and advertising objective. For example, one campaign focuses on website traffic, while another aims to collect contact information from potential business customers. I also prepare several versions of headlines and images for testing.

After the advertisements go live, I check the performance dashboard every day. I pay attention to impressions, clicks, click-through rate, and conversion rate. These numbers help me understand whether people notice the ads and take the actions we want.

Last week, one advertisement received many clicks but generated very few leads. I reviewed the landing page and found that its message did not match the advertisement. Visitors expected a free product demonstration, but the page mainly described product features.

I worked with the content team to make the message clearer and added a visible registration button. The conversion rate improved over the following days. Digital advertising is not simply about spending more money. It requires continuous testing, careful analysis, and regular optimization.
content_cn:
数字广告能够帮助企业触达特定受众，但广告活动需要定期监控。我负责管理公司新软件产品的线上广告投放。我们的主要渠道是 Google Ads 和 LinkedIn。

每次广告活动开始时，我都会确定目标受众、每日预算和广告目标。例如，一项广告活动侧重于增加网站流量，另一项则希望收集潜在企业客户的联系方式。我还会准备多个版本的标题和图片用于测试。

广告上线后，我每天都会查看效果数据面板。我重点关注展示次数、点击次数、点击率和转化率。这些数据能够帮助我了解用户是否注意到了广告，以及是否采取了我们期望的行动。

上周，有一则广告获得了大量点击，却只带来了很少的潜在客户。我检查了落地页，发现页面传达的信息与广告内容不一致。访问者期待的是免费的产品演示，但页面主要介绍产品功能。

我与内容团队合作，让页面信息更加清晰，并添加了醒目的注册按钮。接下来几天，转化率有所提升。数字广告并不只是投入更多资金，它需要持续测试、仔细分析和定期优化。

content_en:
Marketing teams need to measure results to understand whether their activities are creating business value. At the end of each month, I prepare a performance report for our international marketing campaigns.

I begin by collecting data from advertising platforms, website analytics, and our customer relationship management system. I organize the information by market and marketing channel. This allows me to compare performance across different countries and identify where our budget is being used most effectively.

Last month, our campaign in Australia generated a large number of website visits, but the number of sales remained low. In Singapore, traffic was lower, but visitors were more likely to complete a purchase. This showed that high traffic did not always mean strong business results.

I then reviewed the customer journey and found that Australian visitors often left the website during the checkout process. I discussed this issue with the local team and suggested testing different payment options and clearer delivery information.

In the report, I included the main results, possible reasons, and recommended actions. I also compared the results with the previous month to identify changes over time. A useful marketing report should not only present numbers. It should explain what the numbers mean and help the team decide what to do next.
content_cn:
营销团队需要衡量结果，以了解营销活动是否创造了商业价值。每个月月底，我都会为公司的海外营销活动准备一份效果报告。

我首先从广告平台、网站分析工具和客户关系管理系统中收集数据。我按照市场和营销渠道整理信息。这样可以比较不同国家的营销表现，并找出预算使用效率最高的地方。

上个月，我们在澳大利亚的营销活动带来了大量网站访问量，但销售数量仍然较低。在新加坡，网站流量较少，但访问者更有可能完成购买。这说明高流量并不总是意味着良好的商业结果。

随后，我检查了客户旅程，发现澳大利亚访问者经常在结账过程中离开网站。我与当地团队讨论了这个问题，并建议测试不同的支付方式以及更清晰的配送信息。

在报告中，我列出了主要结果、可能的原因和建议采取的行动。我还将本月结果与上个月进行比较，以发现一段时间内的变化。一份有用的营销报告不应该只是展示数字，还应该解释数字的含义，并帮助团队决定下一步应该做什么。

profession_name: International Marketing / 海外市场营销

content_en:
International marketing often involves people working in different countries and time zones. As our company expanded into Europe and Southeast Asia, I needed to coordinate projects with several local marketing teams.

One challenge was communication. A meeting time that worked for our team in China was not always convenient for colleagues in Europe. We started sharing weekly updates in a common project document so that everyone could follow progress without attending every meeting.

Another challenge was balancing global brand consistency with local market needs. The headquarters team wanted to use the same campaign message everywhere, but local teams explained that some examples and promotions were not suitable for their customers. We discussed the differences and agreed on which elements had to remain consistent and which could be adapted.

I also made sure that responsibilities and deadlines were clearly recorded. When a project was delayed, I contacted the relevant team early and discussed a new schedule instead of waiting until the final deadline.

Over time, we developed a better working process. We shared useful campaign examples, documented important decisions, and held regular review meetings. Successful international teamwork depends on clear communication, cultural understanding, and respect for local knowledge.
content_cn:
国际营销工作通常需要不同国家和时区的人员共同参与。随着公司业务扩展到欧洲和东南亚，我需要与多个当地营销团队协调项目。

其中一个挑战是沟通。在中国团队方便的会议时间，对欧洲同事来说不一定合适。我们开始在统一的项目文档中分享每周进展，让每个人即使不参加所有会议，也能了解项目情况。

另一个挑战是在保持全球品牌一致性与满足当地市场需求之间取得平衡。总部团队希望所有市场使用相同的活动信息，但当地团队解释说，一些案例和促销方式并不适合他们的客户。我们讨论了这些差异，并就哪些元素必须保持一致、哪些可以调整达成共识。

我还确保清楚记录每个人的职责和截止日期。当项目出现延迟时，我会尽早联系相关团队，讨论新的时间安排，而不是等到最终期限才处理。

随着时间推移，我们建立了更好的工作流程。我们分享有效的营销案例，记录重要决策，并定期举行复盘会议。成功的国际团队协作依赖清晰沟通、文化理解，以及对当地专业知识的尊重。
